Current internal model:

View A (currently attended location: right, selection probability 0.9986): the right object is almost certainly red and very likely a square (color red ~1.0, shape square ~0.99). Recoverability for that object is ~0.43 now, ~0.31 after one step, ~0.22 after two. The other A locations are represented more weakly: upper is very likely a yellow circle, lower a blue triangle, left a green cross (each with high shape/color probability but very low current selection). If you issue a redirection command in A, predicted next selections are: "upper" → upper (≈1.0), "right" → right (≈1.0), "lower" → lower (≈1.0), "left" → left (≈1.0). Thus commands reliably move attention to the named location.

View B (currently attended location: lower, selection probability 0.9985): the lower object is almost certainly green and a cross. Recoverability ~0.29 now, ~0.21 after one step, ~0.16 after two. Upper is likely a red triangle, right a blue square, left a yellow circle (all with strong color/shape probabilities but low current selection). In B, most redirection commands still predict keeping or moving to lower; however some commands (e.g., selecting upper/right/left) have high probabilities of switching to the named location (right: commands often map to right; upper/right/lower/left mappings in the model indicate reliable control to specific locations).
